comment.et:
<remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Muud küsimused</title><remarkFreeText><translation>
Fraktsioon ECR võttis tagasi muudatusettepaneku 21.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.ga:
<remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Aon ghnó eile</title><remarkFreeText><translation>
Rinne an Grúpa ECR Leasú 21 a tharraingt siar.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.sl:
<remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Razno</title><remarkFreeText><translation>
Skupina ECR je umaknila predlog spremembe 21.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.en:
<remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Miscellaneous</title><remarkFreeText><translation>
The ECR Group had withdrawn Amendment 21.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.fr:
<remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Divers</title><remarkFreeText><translation>
Le groupe ECR a retiré l'amendement 21.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.it:
<remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Varie</title><remarkFreeText><translation>
Il gruppo ECR ha ritirato l'emendamento 21.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.pt:
<remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Diversos</title><remarkFreeText><translation>
O Grupo ECR retirou a alteração 21.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.lv:
<remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Dažādi</title><remarkFreeText><translation>
ECR grupa bija atsaukusi grozījumu Nr. 21.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.es:
<remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Varios</title><remarkFreeText><translation>
El Grupo ECR ha retirado la enmienda 21.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.hr:
<remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Razno</title><remarkFreeText><translation>
Klub zastupnika ECR-a povukao je amandman 21.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.el:
<remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Διάφορα</title><remarkFreeText><translation>
Η Ομάδα ECR απέσυρε την τροπολογία 21.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
